visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title card featuring Japanese niche perfumes. The scene shows multiple small, clear perfume bottles with white caps neatly arranged on a dark wooden shelf in a retail setting. Warm indoor lighting creates a cozy ambiance. (2) The perspective shifts to the storefront of 'Aiam'. A female customer with black hair in a bun and a grey top is seen from behind, walking through the glass doors. Inside, perfume testers are displayed under elegant glass cloches on white pedestals. (3) The brand 'MUCHA' is introduced. The interior features ornate woodwork and classical illustrations inspired by the artist Alphonse Mucha. Close-ups show perfume packaging and bottles adorned with his signature floral art. (4) The third brand 'ROALiv' is showcased. Unique wooden chalices are used for scent testing. A pair of hands with polished nails is shown holding a perfume bottle and spraying a paper scent card. (5) The final sequence displays various ROALiv products on backlit glass shelves, followed by an outro screen with a QR code and social media contact information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日本小眾香水 3選. [Variety]: 回頭率超高仙女香. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: / Aiam /. 8ml ¥4,000、50ml ¥15,000. 這家都是花香調和果香調, 超級適合約會唷! (很有女人味). (3) [Subtitle]: 味道幾乎無雷, 每款都各有特色. [Slogan]: 最推薦 chapter 65 (人氣香). (4) [Subtitle]: 前調: 檸檬、佛手柑、香蘭、塔拉貢. 中調: 玫瑰、橙花、迷迭香. 後調: 麝香、琥珀、雪松. (5) [Subtitle]: 除了香水之外, 還有身體保養、擴香等產品. 櫃位還蠻多的, 到日本玩千萬不要錯過. (6) [Subtitle]: / MUCHA /. 10ml ¥3,960、35ml ¥9,790、95ml ¥15,950. 以藝術家慕夏的作品作為靈感發想. (7) [Subtitle]: 包裝美翻了, 根本可以當作收藏品. 我第一次逛就整個被迷住. [Slogan]: 最有人氣的是這罐 LILY, 香味清香不俗套. (8) [Subtitle]: 是很優雅的味道, 日常就能噴. MUCHA 多為花香調, 送人自用都很推! (9) [Subtitle]: / ROALiv /. 20ml ¥3,960. 這個品牌的調香相當特別, 聞過一次就忘不了! 我最愛 ninetieth. (10) [Subtitle]: 它是有皮革味的木質香, 調香非常高級, 超適合秋冬!!! (11) [Subtitle]: 喜歡清新香味的話, 可以試試 black tea 和 clear. 一罐不用台幣 1,000, CP值很高!!! (12) [Variety]: 快傳給身邊的香水控! 香水控本人記得先收藏起來. 掃描上方 QR code 領取「日本百貨優惠券總整理」.
